notes:
New Stuff
- Ko-fi is now a real citizen: Commission, Subscription, Resubscription, and Shop Order all work
- You can now set a separate font family, weight, style, and transform for the message line
- Latest Events widget so you can show off the recent chaos on stream
- Alert nav is now grouped by platform with icons because the list was getting ridiculous

Fixes
- Message fonts actually apply now in both global and per-type mode (they weren't, sorry)
- Ko-fi and YouTube alerts stopped pretending to be Twitch alerts in the Streamer.bot action
- Archivo Black and other named-weight fonts no longer fall back to boring sans-serif
- Old configs with message lines disabled get migrated automatically, no manual fix needed
